english.title: AATF operator/approved exporter fail to allow authority to assess Schedule 11 conditions met (from 1st January 2019)

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being an

(A)_[operator of an AATF,]_
(B)_[approved exporter,]_

failed to allow **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the appropriate authority, to assess whether the conditions in paragraph 24 of Schedule 11 to the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 had been met during the relevant approval period
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 66(7), 90(7)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being an operator of an AATF or approved exporter,
failed to allow the appropriate authority to assess
whether the conditions in paragraph 24 of Schedule 11 to the regulations had been met during the relevant approval period

english.notes: This wording applies to offences committed on and after 1st January 2019
